messages:
Maria (infra): FYI we're starting rack consolidation in us-west-1 to reduce idle GPU capacity. planning to fold 5 racks into 3 over next 48h. Expect transient allocation pressure.
Kevin: Any SLO risk? what about noisy neighbors? :thinking: 
Maria (infra): Short answer: yes risk to p99 for some tenants. long answer: swapping racks will increase cross-rack egress and NIC queueing; some tenants already near PCIe/HBM thermal margins.
Sahil: Can we throttle specific tenants? we should avoid broad preemptions.
Liz: +1. suggest marking heavy batch tenants as "burst-limited" and adjust routing weights. also add ToR QoS for tenant-egress class.
Kevin: Do we have telemetry showing which tenants cause most tail latency during prior micro-migrations?
Maria (infra): Attached snippet of query (we paste):
```
SELECT tenant_id, p99_latency, nic_drop_rate FROM telemetry
WHERE window='last_6h' AND rack IN ('rack-11','rack-12')
ORDER BY p99_latency DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Maria (infra): Top hits: tenant-42 (large batched embed jobs), tenant-77 (sparse but heavy), tenant-5 (A/B testing traffic spike)
David (oncall): ops-bot just alerted earlier about Rack-12 NIC saturation at 03:12. I can hold off consolidation until we implement soft-shields.
ops-bot: [alert] TO RACK-12 NIC queue 98% for 7m, samples: 42k pps.
Sahil: Proposed mitigations: 1) soft-shield tenants: limit concurrent slots to 60% 2) per-tenant NIC qdisc shaping on ToR 3) route heavy-embedding to dedicated slice if available 4) increase eviction backoff for long-running lite workers
Liz: How do we enforce soft-shield config? any quick CLI? 
Maria (infra): We have allocator flag --soft_shield=<tenant>, use this rollout:
```
allocctl patch --tenant tenant-42 --flags soft_shield=0.6
```
Kevin: Cost question: moving to dedicated slices for these tenants increases committed GPUs. how do we amortize cost?
Maria (infra): Trade-off: short-term cost bump vs p99 reduction and SLA credit avoidance. propose temporary 30d reservation with review.
David (oncall): I'll schedule a canary: hold rack consolidation by 6h, apply soft-shields to top-3 tenants, monitor p99 and NIC drops.
Liz: +1. I'll coordinate with networking to add AFQ qdisc on the ToRs in the affected AZ.
Sahil: I'll prepare a short playbook with rollback steps. will post links.
Maria (infra): Thanks team. tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:
